ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) localized clusters; macro-level white-to-black ratio is estimated at < 0.05 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across 95%+ of the visible area. Discrete high-contrast white focal spots (0.5-2.0% area) are distributed non-uniformly across both lobes, with a distinct concentration of linear high-intensity streaks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle (estimated < 45 degrees); vertical bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth profile along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced in the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Initial convex curvature from the median notch transitioning into a nearly linear distal sweep, terminating in sharp, upwardly-tapered points at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, particularly visible in the lower-medial regions and near the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe oriented diagonally; shorter horizontal linear disruptions are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake mark scarring on the right lobe distal-medial quadrant; extensive irregular serration and potential minor chipping on the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive sharp upward vertical orientation of the distal tips relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke body.
